text: The North Island Drought Financial Assistance initiative was launched by the New Zealand Government to provide targeted financial support to regions affected by the 2020 North Island drought. The initiative aims to sustain essential services, particularly drinking water, and support recovery efforts. It operates within a broader national policy framework that emphasizes long-term economic resilience to climate-related shocks, informed by scientific assessments of drought risk.
